subject.title: Memory system: Cannot delete stale memories, conflicting entries persist

question: What memory cleanup contract should memory-lancedb support for recall-to-forget handoff and stale/conflicting fact correction?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the durable behavior could be solved by visible UUIDs, numeric selectors with scoped state, query fallback, replace/deprecate semantics, or the broader tombstone/supersede lifecycle; automation should not choose that product/API boundary.

options.title: Define lifecycle contract first
options.body: Use the open Memory MVP tracker to settle deletion handles, tombstone/supersede semantics, provenance, and conflict resolution before queueing implementation.

options.title: Narrow to visible recall IDs
options.body: Approve an additive memory_recall content change that exposes UUIDs while leaving replacement/deprecation semantics to the broader tracker.

options.title: Defer this symptom to Memory MVP
options.body: Keep the current tools unchanged and handle the report only through the broader review/edit/forget/conflict-resolution design work.

recommendation.title: Define lifecycle contract first
recommendation.body: Use the open Memory MVP tracker to settle deletion handles, tombstone/supersede semantics, provenance, and conflict resolution before queueing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent memory-lancedb maintainer-path signal and merged the adjacent candidate-list UUID fix, while broader lifecycle direction should still include the Memory MVP owners.
